sections.title: Airplane Island
sections.notes:
44" x 21" x .5" static airplane use case.
Meant to look like it's flying through the clouds, with Amazon LEO attached to the top.
Cloud construction TBD. No LED.

sections.title: Oil Rig Island
sections.notes:
44" x 21" x .5" offshore oil rig use case over ocean water texture.
3D printed oil rig plus off-the-shelf model research vessel.
No kinetic elements. Off-the-shelf lighting possible if time allows.
LEO placement TBD.

sections.title: Camping Island
sections.notes:
24" x 21" x .5" remote wilderness campground use case.
Rock/grass/dirt/lake ground texture, 2 off-the-shelf camper vans, model trees.
Amazon LEO on the vans.
No LED lighting or kinetic parts.

sections.title: Desert Island
sections.notes:
24" x 21" x .5" desert home on desert ground cover.
Home 3D printed or routed, built so interior details aren't visible.
Desert shrubs and rocks, maybe a model car. Amazon LEO on the house.
No LED lighting in the house; off-the-shelf driveway lighting or similar possible. No kinetic elements.
